name: 維爾冬男性偏文 · 投擲武器
prompt: Production 2D hand-painted fantasy RPG animation sprite atlas. SQUARE RGB OPAQUE PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no alpha. EXACT 6 columns by 6 rows, thirty-six SEPARATE full-body miniature sprites. Same person, costume, weapon, scale and right-facing three-quarter view every frame. Each sprite no more than 65% cell width, generous 35px magenta gutters, NO touching neighbouring poses. No text, no grid lines, no scenery or floor. Adult anatomy, fine painterly details at 150px character height, NOT chibi, NOT 3D. SUBJECT: slender adult northern man with swept ash-blond hair, neat braid and no beard, deep blue long wool coat, ivory fur collar, bronze knotwork clasps, rune-carved belt and fitted brown boots. Held equipment MUST be: two small metal throwing daggers, one drawn in right hand and one in belt. SIX ROWS, each six frames: ROW1 idle breathing loop; ROW2 attack: ready, anticipation, windup, strong contact/release, follow-through, recovery. Raise throwing arm behind shoulder, twist torso then whip arm forward releasing one tiny dagger with a short motion trace, draw replacement. ROW3 hit recoil and recovery; ROW4 defensive guard and recovery using this actual equipment, no extra sword; ROW5 evasive crouch step then recovery; ROW6 collapse/defeat ending lying motionless. SAME costume throughout: slender adult northern man with swept ash-blond hair, neat braid and no beard, deep blue long wool coat, ivory fur collar, bronze knotwork clasps, rune-carved belt and fitted brown boots. Weapon must remain recognizable, same proportions, grip anatomically correct. No swords except those explicitly requested. No touching neighbours. Solid opaque magenta everywhere between characters, no transparency.
